# Support line items per cloud provider on invoices — concept pack (small)

> Source-anchored research for Support line items per cloud provider on invoices. Run status: COMPLETED.

<!-- generated by llms-concept-abstractor v1.4.1 · generated 2026-10-24 · budgeted to ≈8000 tokens; the full catalogue is llms-full.txt -->

## Measurements and reference values

- [statement] Atlas apportions support charges by cloud usage and lists separate provider support rows. Its example divides support 50% to AWS, 30% to Google Cloud, and 20% to Microsoft Azure. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-18) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/billing/additional-services/ · keywords: Support line items per cloud provider on invoices · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/billing/invoice-breakdown/

## Facts and statements

- [statement] The invoice Summary shows total monthly paid support; Details shows the provider-level support line items. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-18) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/billing/additional-services/
- [statement] A provider without usage has no support row. Support usage without a cloud association appears under Other Atlas Usage. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-18) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/billing/additional-services/ · keywords: Support line items per cloud provider on invoices · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/billing/invoice-breakdown/
- [statement] Atlas applies one monthly support minimum to the entire organization, separately from provider allocation. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-18) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/billing/additional-services/ · keywords: Support line items per cloud provider on invoices · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/billing/invoice-breakdown/
- [statement] For marketplace commitments, Atlas routes each provider's support to that marketplace. With mixed payments, other provider charges can go directly to Atlas. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-18) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/billing/invoice-breakdown/
- [statement] If monthly support usage falls below the minimum, Atlas charges the difference to the primary payment method at month end. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-18) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/billing/invoice-breakdown/
